content:
# cigster-118: Add PostHog for field Web Vitals / INP

PR #118, closes ticket #104. Two Bugbot review comments, both fixed in the PR.

## Story

- Title: the PR title.
- Why: present, from #104. The team wants field INP by route template on the PostHog free plan.
- Size: medium.
- Parts: 2. Web vitals (#104) and product events. The product events have no source and could be their own PR. Groups: 4 to 6.

## Groups

Web vitals part:

1. PostHog setup and enable gate: `src/lib/analytics/posthog.ts` (config and `isPostHogEnabled`), `src/routes/__root.tsx`, `src/global.d.ts`, `package.json`.
2. Join-code privacy: `before_send` in `posthog.ts`, `src/lib/analytics/routeTemplate.ts`, and the `ph-no-capture` hunks in `JoinCodeBadge.tsx`, `TvStage.tsx`, `PlayerJoin.tsx`, `HostLobby.tsx`. This can merge with group 1 because `posthog.ts` holds both.
3. Reverse proxy at `/ph`: `netlify.toml`, `vite.config.ts`.
4. PostHog off in e2e: `compose.yaml`, `e2e/playwright.config.ts`.

Product events part:

5. Named `posthog.capture` calls: `LandingHero.tsx`, `ImportConsole.tsx`, `sets/index.tsx`, `play/$slug.tsx`, `game/$code.tsx`, and the capture hunks in `HostLobby.tsx` and `PlayerJoin.tsx`. No `dependsOn` into the web vitals part.

## Must state

- The ticket asks to keep product autocapture off. The change keeps autocapture on. The PR says so but gives no reason.
- `before_send` removes join codes from event titles and autocapture text. That includes bare six-character codes on host and TV routes, where the code is not in the path. This is the fix for the two Bugbot comments.
- The ticket asks to filter or sample so `$web_vitals` does not use up the free quota when more events come. The change adds no sampling, keeps autocapture on, turns on exception capture, and adds nine product events that neither source asks for.

## Good to state

- PostHog also runs on deploy previews and branch deploys, because those builds are production builds with the same project token. The ticket scopes it to production.
- The proxy uses `/ph` because `/ingest` is the app's song-import route.
- The redaction can remove too much. It replaces every route param value in all event strings, and any word that looks like a join code, for example `UPDATE`.

## Must not

- Do not turn the PR test plan into "confirm X" bullets.
- Do not chain the product events to the web vitals groups with `dependsOn`.
- Do not split the npm dependencies into a group of their own.

## Baseline

- 4 of 6 runs stated the autocapture claim in a way the grader accepted. 5 of 6 stated the `before_send` claim.
- 2 of 6 named the missing sampling.
- 6 of 6 runs chained the product events to the web vitals groups with `dependsOn`. Only 1 gave them their own part.
- Runs made 7 to 8 groups. Most document `lookFor` bullets restated the test plan.

## case.json

- `parts` 0–3 to 2–3.
- `apart`: `posthog.ts` and `ImportConsole.tsx`, next to the existing `routeTemplate.ts` and `LandingHero.tsx` pair.
- Added the sampling and quota claim.
